owner: LLD-02 supplies reference/query/action state; LLD-10 owns rendering/components/interactions

candidate_states.ui_rule: offer explicit create/select-alternative workflow only where owning domain permits; do not create automatically
show immutable candidate identity and supporting exact-match evidence; candidate is not an implicit accepted link
show exact candidate_count plus bounded/paginated qualified candidates with scope/evidence; require explicit resolution or stronger evidence; page size never changes ambiguity

customer_account_code.preferred_evidence: surface exact Account Code match separately from display-name evidence
customer_account_code.conflict: ACCOUNT_CODE_CONFLICT_REVIEW opens PreviewCustomerAccountCodeConflict for the exact proposed action; show claimant count/paged identities and no default winner
customer_account_code.review_binding: confirmation submits the exact server-derived review_snapshot_hash. REVIEW_CONTEXT_STALE forces reload/review; UI must not silently resubmit a newly generated hash without renewed operator confirmation
customer_account_code.shared_claim: when more than one eligible canonical claimant exists, label code as ambiguous/reviewed shared evidence rather than unique ownership
customer_account_code.history: superseded claims remain visible on explicit history surface

contact_affiliation.current: show current Customer Organization or Unbound
contact_affiliation.history: history surface is paginated and lists closed affiliations without rewriting Contact identity
contact_affiliation.mismatch_warning: when consuming domain reports Contact-current-affiliation != operation Customer context, show warning/review choices; never silently reassign or duplicate Contact

contact_channels.current: active/archived channels are explicit and paginated when needed
contact_channels.recipient_action: recipient-dependent workflows request ValidateContactChannelForUse; MISSING/ARCHIVED/INVALID blocks only that communication-dependent action; MULTIPLE_USABLE requires explicit channel selection unless the consuming workflow has separately accepted deterministic selection authority
contact_channels.multiple_usable: display exact usable_count and bounded candidate channels; never choose first row, oldest, newest, or lexical order as implicit business authority
contact_channels.safety: recipient values render strictly as text; LLD-10 must not inject raw channel values as HTML

archive.preview: show exact blocker count and bounded paginated blockers grouped in deterministic validator/domain order with safe_next_action
archive.blocked: Archive command may return blocker-with-preview-required after transactional guard; UI refreshes read-only preview instead of expecting blocker enumeration under writer lock
archive.eligible: requires explicit archive action; commit may still return stale/blocker conflict after revalidation
archive.reactivation: explicit action with fresh conflict validation

dispatch_location.customer_neutrality: do not show Customer ownership/preference as editable Dispatch Location fields
dispatch_location.address_source: label current address as Standalone or Site-derived when useful; Site-derived address edits navigate to/execute LLD-08 Site owner rather than writing Dispatch Location address
dispatch_location.operation_role: delivery/pickup/return role is selected/stored by consuming logistics workflow, not edited on location master

settings.source_badge: distinguish DEFAULT from PERSISTED without creating a row
settings.validation: semantic owner errors remain field/action specific
settings.secrets: ordinary Settings surface never receives raw secret values belonging to LLD-12

no_change: NO_CHANGE is presented as successful already-current state without pretending a domain change occurred; UI does not invent a history/audit event for it.
conflict_rule: Every edit/archive/reactivate/channel/account-code/setting mutation carries last accepted revision/equivalent precondition; STALE_REVISION or REVIEW_CONTEXT_STALE reloads current state and preserves recoverable working copy under LLD-10 rules.
